card.name: Separators in lists and section numbers
card.fires_on: Commas between items in long lowercase keyword lists, and the dot or colon in numbered headings such as 5.1 or 2.2. Also bullet marks in menu-style lists.

modes.label: Commas in keyword lists
modes.description: Comma after a single noun in a long run of topic words, such as coloring-page categories.

modes.label: Dot in section numbers
modes.description: The point inside a numbered label heading, right after the first digit.

modes.label: Bullets and sense numbers
modes.description: A bullet mark in a name list, or a colon after a numbered dictionary sense.
